risks.risk: Exact model is unknown or misstated, which strongly affects price tier (e.g., 550D vs 650D vs 1300D vs 4000D).
risks.proof: Clear photo of the model nameplate/sticker on the camera body (usually near the viewfinder or on the base) or the serial number sticker under the battery door.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest plausible entry-level Canon DSLR tier matching this body style

risks.risk: LCD screen may be cracked, dead, or have display faults, not visible since it is shown closed/off.
risks.proof: Photo of the screen powered on showing a live image or menu.
risks.if_unproven: priced as screen not confirmed working

risks.risk: Lens optics could have fungus, scratches, or haze, which is common in used kit lenses and not visible from the exterior shots.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of front and rear lens elements against a light source.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens condition unverified/worst case

risks.risk: Shutter count/sensor wear is unknown, a major value factor for DSLRs.
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from a shutter-count checking tool or app, or a few sample photos showing image quality.

risks.risk: Accessories (battery, charger, memory card, strap, box) may or may not be included, affecting value.
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body and lens only, no accessories

risks.risk: Internal mechanical faults (mirror, autofocus motor, memory card slot) cannot be assessed from exterior photos alone.

risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed working, worst case

proof_requests: Clear, well-lit photo of the model name/number plate or serial number sticker on the camera body.
Photo or video of the camera powered on with the LCD screen displaying a live view or menu.
Close-up photos of the front and rear lens elements for fungus/scratches.
Short video showing shutter firing, autofocus working, and a memory card being accepted.
Photo of all accessories included in the sale (battery, charger, card, strap, box).
